extracted.name: Popcorn Cauliflower
extracted.description: Bite-size cauliflower pieces are coated in a sweet and savory spice blend and roasted into a popcorn-like treat you can serve as a side dish or snack.
ingredient_lines: 2 heads cauliflower, cut into bite-size pieces
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Whisk sugar, salt, paprika, turmeric, onion powder, and garlic powder together in a bowl.
Spread cauliflower onto the prepared baking sheet; spray liberally with cooking spray. Season cauliflower with spice mixture.
Roast in the preheated oven until cauliflower is tender, 30 to 35 minutes.
